messages:
mateo: Quick sync — I'm landing a TF change to attach spokes to the TGW with AZ affinity. Wanted a quick config review.

julia: can you paste the relevant snippet? i want to check route propagation + route table associations.

mateo: sure, here's the key part:
```
resource "aws_ec2_transit_gateway_vpc_attachment" "spoke" {
  transit_gateway_id = var.tgw_id
  vpc_id             = aws_vpc.spoke.id
  subnet_ids         = [aws_subnet.spoke-a.id, aws_subnet.spoke-b.id]
  options {
    appliance_mode_support = "enable"
    dns_support            = "enable"
  }
}
```

sasha: two quick q's: (1) why only two subnets? we need one per AZ for AZ-failover. (2) are you setting auto-create-default-route? also check TGW route table association.

mateo: good call. plan was to keep an AZ pair for cost, but we should mirror prod with 3 subnets. i'll add spoke-c. Also adding explicit `aws_ec2_transit_gateway_route_table_association` blocks.

olivia: re: NAT — the TF change moves NATs to a small pool per AZ. make sure EIP allocation is idempotent. previous PR caused TF to try to re-create EIPs.

mateo: here's the NAT config i'm proposing:
```
resource "aws_eip" "nat" {
  count = var.enable_nat ? length(var.azs) : 0
  vpc   = true
  depends_on = [aws_internet_gateway.igw]
}

resource "aws_nat_gateway" "nat" {
  count = length(aws_eip.nat)
  allocation_id = aws_eip.nat[count.index].id
  subnet_id     = element(var.public_subnets, count.index)
}
```

ryan: better to use `lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }` on nat gateway so TF won't drop traffic. Also add `ignore_changes = [allocation_id]` on nat if managed outside TF sometimes.

julia: add a note in the module readme about how EIPs are owned. we've been bitten by shared-eip pools before.

sasha: small nit — in the TGW attachment, set `appliance_mode_support = "disable"` unless you're routing through a firewall appliance. that value changes packet behavior.

mateo: ah thanks, we *are* using a firewall in one region. i'll gate by var.use_firewall.

olivia: also, when you update TGW route tables, remember to add the `aws_ram_resource_association` for cross-account spokes. we had missing permissions last time.

infra-bot: terraform plan for branch mateo/tgw-affinity completed: 2 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy — https://ci.internal/redwood/terraform-plan/2345 :white_check_mark:

mateo: linking PR: https://github.com/redwood-infra/networking/pull/678 — PTAL. I'll update to 3 AZs and add lifecycle blocks.

ryan: will review this afternoon. flagged for you in the PR.

julia: one more: are route table tags consistent? TGW uses tags for automation. add `tags = merge(var.tags, { "tgw-attached" = aws_vpc.spoke.id })` so scripts can find attached vpcs.

mateo: good idea. will add tags and a changelog entry. plan to apply Wed after 10pm UTC unless blockers.

sasha: i'm ok with Wed night. can we add a quick rollback playbook in the PR description? last time rollback steps were unclear.

mateo: on it — I'll paste `tfstate` restore steps + aws cli commands.

olivia: FYI I'll coordinate with support for any potential transient NAT flaps.

mateo: thanks all. will update the PR shortly.

infra-bot: deploy job queued for 2024-10-09 22:00 UTC (watch: #eng-oncall)
